alerts.headline: Rip Current Statement issued October 2 at 2:51AM CDT until October 5 at 7:00PM CDT by NWS Mobile AL
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Dangerous rip currents.

* WHERE...In Alabama, Baldwin Coastal County. In Florida,
Escambia Coastal, Santa Rosa Coastal and Okaloosa Coastal
Counties.

* WHEN...Through Monday evening.

* IMPACTS...Rip currents can sweep even the best swimmers away
from shore into deeper water.
